moments.text: Black-and-white infrared view, green crosshair and corner brackets: dark sky over a bright band of cloud tops, with a pale elongated shape on it.
The sensor swings: a bright band sweeps across, the picture turns dark and blurred, then layered cloud comes into view.
A small dark elongated shape enters at the upper right edge, slides left across the top of the frame and lingers upper left.
A small white dot enters at the right edge, crosses the upper third right to left and exits left; the sensor does not follow.
The view tilts onto towering bright cloud.
The picture jumps to a wider view: rows of small clouds under a dark band of sky.
A tiny white dot emerges above the lower-right redaction box and moves left; the view zooms in, pans left, and the dot exits lower left.
The sensor keeps panning left in steps over rows of cloud until the clip ends.

notes: Clip appears to be ~15 fps content in a 30 fps file (duplicated frames).
